name: echo-sentiment
description: Pay-per-call sentiment analysis MCP server with x402 micropayments (dual-chain Base + Solana). Returns sentiment scores for text; every tool call demands 0.005 USDC via x402 payment protocol.

tools.name: analyze_sentiment

tools.name: analyze_sentiment_batch

authentication.description: HTTP 402 challenge-response micropayments via x402 protocol; no API keys required.
